title: Patch v0.2.Y: the yellow condition glow for ten Core cards
notes: The yellow 'condition met' glow (R662) for Bread and Butter, Bear Honeypot, Unlicensed Experimentation, My Pawn, Spiteful Stab and Ceaseless Void, and for the hand cards Quickstriker, Gifted Program and a Radiant /fullsend grant a condition to; Sheepish never glows. Only each script's line count moves; no card plays differently.
